question_text: What were the problems that Ashoka wanted to solve by introducing dhamma?
answer_text:
The problems that Ashoka wanted to solve by introducing dhamma were:
• Religious conflict
• Animal sacrifice
• Ill-treatment of slaves and servants
• Quarrels in families and amongst neighbours.
final_answer: Ashoka aimed to solve issues like religious conflict and the ill-treatment of slaves through dhamma.
difficulty_reasoning: Requires understanding of Ashoka's motivations and social issues.

subject: history
chapter_name: ashoka the emperor who gave up the war
question_text: What were the means adopted by Ashoka to spread the message of dhamma?
answer_text:
The means that Ashoka adopted to spread the message of dhamma were:
• He appointed officials, known as the dhamma mahamatta who went from place to place teaching people about dhamma.
• He got his messages inscribed on rocks and pillars, instructing his officials to read his message to those who could not read it themselves.
• He also sent messengers to spread ideas about dhamma to other lands, such as Syria, Egypt, Greece and Sri Lanka.
final_answer: Ashoka spread dhamma through officials, inscriptions, and messengers to other lands.
difficulty_reasoning: Involves understanding multiple methods of communication and outreach.
